name: How long does prefab ADU site preparation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does prefab ADU site preparation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of prefab ADU site preparation varies depending on the site's complexity and scope of work. Factors like tree removal, extensive grading, or new utility line installations can extend the timeline. Typically, basic site preparation can range from a few weeks to a couple of months. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed project timeline after the initial site assessment, allowing customers to understand the anticipated schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Site preparation duration varies, typically from weeks to months, depending on complexity like grading or utility work.
